segments.say: What if I told you, you can give away your queen, and still checkmate in two moves?
segments.caption: Give away the QUEEN?!

segments.say: A normal start. Both sides develop.
segments.caption: Normal opening

segments.say: Knight to c3. Black plays g6. A tiny mistake.
segments.caption: Small mistake...

segments.say: Now the knight takes e5, leaving the queen hanging. Black grabs it.
segments.caption: Free queen?

segments.say: Bishop takes f7, check. The king must move.
segments.caption: Check!

segments.say: Knight to d5. Checkmate. Black has the queen, and lost anyway.
segments.caption: Knight d5!

segments.say: This is Legal's Mate, a trap that's over two hundred years old. Save this and try it in your next game.
segments.caption: Save it for your next game
